children.name: text
children: {b:TERMS AND CONDITIONS ('THE TERMS') FOR THE SMALL WORKS SUB-SUBCONTRACT ORDER AGREEMENT}

children.name: text
children: Insofar as anything in these Terms is inconsistent with any terms or conditions contained in the Sub-Subcontractor's quotation and forming part of the Sub-Subcontract, these terms shall prevail.

children.name: text
children: {b:1. {u:Definitions:}} Words and expressions used in this Sub-Subcontract shall have the same meanings as in the Main Contract except where the context otherwise requires. {em:Sub-Contractor} means the company so defined in the Small Works Sub-Subcontract Order Agreement (the Order). {em:Sub-Subcontractor} means the party to whom the Order is addressed or, where the context so admits, his servants or agents. {em:Sub-Subcontract} means the Sub-Subcontract Agreement between the Sub-Contractor and the Sub-Subcontractor comprising the Order, these terms, and such other documents as may be specified in the Order. {em:Main Contract} means the Contract entered into between the Employer and the Contractor. {em:Sub-Contract} means the contract entered into between the Contractor and the Sub-Contractor. {em:Works} means the main contract works including the Sub-Subcontract Works. {em:Architect/Contract Administrator (CA)} means the person appointed by the Employer to administer and supervise the Works. {em:Employer} means the person with whom the Contractor has entered into the Main Contract. {em:Contractor} means the entity with whom the Sub-Contractor has entered into the Sub-Contract. {em:Sub-Subcontract Works} means that portion of the Works to be carried out and completed by the Sub-Subcontractor in accordance with these terms and described in the Order. {em:BR Principal Contractor} shall mean the person(s) named as the BR Principal Contractor in the Main Contract or any successor appointed by the Employer. {em:BR Principal Designer} shall mean the person(s) named as the BR Principal Designer in the Main Contract or any successor appointed by the Employer. {em:Building Regulations} means the Building Regulations 2010, Building Safety Act means the Building Safety Act 2022; {em:Organisational Capability} shall mean the appropriate management policies, procedures, systems and resources to ensure that individuals under the control of the Sub-Subcontractor comply with their relevant competence requirements in accordance with the CDM Regulations and Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: {b:2. {u:Execution of the Sub-Subcontract Works:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall commence the Sub-Subcontract Works and each section thereof on site within the Notice to Commence Period stated in the Order or if no Notice to Commence Period is so stated, within 7 days of the Sub-Contractor's instruction to do so, and shall regularly and diligently proceed with the same and shall complete the same within the times stated in the Order subject only to any extensions of which may be granted by the Sub-Contractor under these terms. Nothing in this clause shall be construed as preventing the Sub-Subcontractor from commencing off site any work necessary for the execution of the Sub-Subcontract Works at any time before receipt of the Sub-Contractor's written instructions to commence on site.

children.name: text
children: {b:3.} The Sub-Subcontractor shall execute and complete the Sub-Subcontract Works in all respects to the satisfaction of the Sub-Contractor (and the Contractor) and in conformity with all reasonable directions and requirements of the Sub-Contractor including all reasonable rules of the Sub-Contractor for the time being regulating the due execution of the Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:4.} Insofar as the Sub-Subcontract Works have been or will be designed and materials and goods have been or will be selected by the Sub-Subcontractor, the Sub-Subcontractor shall be responsible for the design of the Sub-Subcontract Works and the selection of materials and goods. He will also be responsible for the satisfaction of any performance specification or requirements insofar as such performance specification or requirements are included or referred to in the Order or as part of the description of the Sub-Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:4A.} In the event that the Sub-Contractor has reasonable cause to believe that the Sub-Subcontractor is unwilling, unable or unlikely to complete the Sub-Subcontract Works within the time required by the Sub-Subcontract, then the Sub-Contractor may, without prejudice to any other rights the Sub-Contractor may possess under this Sub-Subcontract omit the whole or any part of the Sub-Subcontract Works as remain outstanding at that time, in which case the value of the omitted work shall be deducted from the Sub-Subcontract Sum and the Sub-Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any loss and/or expense associated therewith and, notwithstanding any other applicable clause in this Sub-Subcontract, the Sub-Contractor may, in writing, fix a period or periods for completion of the Sub-Subcontract Works which is shorter than the period or periods stated in this Sub-Subcontract and/or augment the Sub-Subcontractor's labour force, design team or other resources, in which case the Sub-Subcontractor shall reimburse the Sub-Contractor for the actual costs incurred by the Sub-Contractor in connection with any such augmentation.

children.name: text
children: {b:4B.} Building Regulations and the Building Safety Act

children.name: text
children: {b:4B.1} The Sub-Subcontractor undertakes to the Sub-Contractor that in relation to the Works and site it will have regard to and comply with all applicable Building Regulations, and the Building Safety Act and accompanying legislation including without limitation regulations 11F, 11J, 11K and 11L of Part 2A of the Building Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:4B.2} The Sub-Subcontractor warrants and undertakes to the Sub-Contractor that it has the skill, knowledge and experience (and if the Sub-Subcontractor is an organisation, the Organisational Capability), necessary to demonstrate compliance with clause 4.B.1 and the Sub-Subcontractor shall immediately notify the Sub-Contractor where the Sub-Subcontractor ceases to satisfy the requirements of clause 4.B.1:

children.name: text
children: {b:4.B.3} The Sub-Subcontractor shall liaise with and provide all reasonable assistance required by the Sub-Contractor, the accountable person and/or the principal accountable person under the Building Safety Act (where not the Sub-Contractor) and/or the BR Principal Designer (where not the Sub-Contractor) and/or the BR Principal Contractor (where not the Sub-Contractor) to comply with the requirements of the Building Safety Act;

children.name: text
children: {b:4.B.4} For the avoidance of doubt, the Sub-Subcontractor shall comply with its duties under the Building Regulations, the Building Safety Act and accompanying legislation at no cost to the Sub-Contractor and such compliance shall not be treated as a variation or give rise to any extra cost to the Sub-Contractor (or any other addition to the Contract Sum) or to any entitlement for an extension of time under clause 9

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:5. Liability under incorporated provisions of Sub-Contract and Main Contract:}}

children.name: text
children: {b:5.1} be deemed to have notice of and to have had reasonable opportunity of inspecting the Sub-Contract (except the rates and prices of the Sub-Contractor) and the parts of the Main Contract as are relevant to the Sub-Subcontract Works and shall observe perform and comply with and be bound by all the provisions of the Sub-Contract and the Main Contract so far as they relate and apply to the Sub-Subcontract Works (or any portion of the same);

children.name: text
children: {b:5.2} indemnify and save harmless the Sub-Contractor against and from: any breach, non-observance or non-performance by the Sub-Subcontractor of any of the Sub-Contract provisions and/or the Main Contract provisions insofar as they are relevant to the Sub-Subcontract Works; and any act or omission of the Sub-Subcontractor which involves the Sub-Contractor in any liability to the Contractor or Employer; and any proceedings, claim, damage, loss or expense incurred or suffered by the Sub-Contractor due to or resulting from any negligence or breach of duty by the Sub-Subcontractor; and

children.name: text
children: {b:5.3} agree that in the event that the Contractor withholds monies or seeks to recover monies from the Sub-Contractor as a result of damage caused by the Sub-Subcontractor or by any persons engaged or authorised by the Sub-Subcontractor (whether in relation to the Sub-Subcontract Works or to the works of others or to the site generally), the Sub-Contractor reserves the right to deduct such costs from sums otherwise due to the Sub-Subcontractor. Alternatively, the Sub-Contractor may recover such costs from the Sub-Subcontractor as a debt. Such costs may include, but are not limited to, costs for repairs, replacements, penalties, or any other expenses.

children.name: text
children: {b:6.} In performing the Sub-Subcontract Works, the Sub-Subcontractor shall have regard to the obligations of the Sub-Contractor under the Sub-Contract and to the obligations of the Employer and/or Contractor and/or Sub-Contractor under the Main Contract and/or any other agreement or document to which any of those entities is or may become party, the relevant terms of which are notified to the Sub-Subcontractor. The Sub-Subcontractor shall exercise reasonable skill, care and diligence to avoid any act, omission, or default of the Sub-Subcontractor causing or contributing to any breach by the Sub-Contractor, Contractor or the Employer of such obligations. The Sub-Subcontractor shall further take full account of any interests or rights enjoyed by any third party in or over the Site (including, without limitation, any easements and rights of way, air or light) and any restrictions or other encumbrances affecting the Site and shall ensure that the same are not in any way infringed by the carrying out of the Sub-Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:7. Damages:}} If the Sub-Subcontractor fails to complete the Sub-Subcontract Works within the period for completion or any revised period as provided in clause 9, the Sub-Contractor shall so notify the Sub-Subcontractor in writing and upon receipt of that notice the Sub-Subcontractor shall pay or allow to the Sub-Contractor a sum equivalent to any direct loss and/or expense suffered or incurred by the Sub-Contractor and caused by the said default of the Sub-Subcontractor, such sum to be payable to the Sub-Contractor as a debt.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:8. Indemnity:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall be liable for and shall indemnify the Sub-Contractor against every liability whatsoever which the Sub-Contractor may incur to any other person and against all claims demands proceedings damages costs and expenses made against or incurred by the Sub-Contractor by reason of any breach by the Sub-Subcontractor of the Sub-Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:9. Extension of time:}} If the Sub-Subcontractor is delayed in the execution of the Sub-Subcontract Works by any event entitling the Sub-Contractor to an extension of time under the Sub-Contract, or by any variation of the Sub-Subcontract Works which is also a variation under the Sub-Contract or by any breach of this Sub-Subcontract by the Sub-Contractor then the Sub-Contractor shall grant such extension of time or times as may in all the circumstances be fair and reasonable. It shall be a condition precedent to the Sub-Subcontractor's entitlement to an extension of time under this Sub-Subcontract that the Sub-Subcontractor notify the Sub-Contractor of the claim for an extension of time within 4 calendar weeks (or such alternative period as notified by the Sub-Contractor to the Sub-Subcontractor in writing in order to comply with the notification requirements of the Sub-Contract) of the Sub-Subcontractor becoming aware of the occurrence of the grounds for an extension of time. If the Sub-Subcontractor does not notify the Sub-Contractor of the claim for an extension of time within the period set out in this clause 9 then the Sub-Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any extension of time in respect of such claim.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:10. Variations:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall make such variations of the Sub-Subcontract Works, whether by addition, modification or omission as may be ordered by the Sub-Contractor and confirmed in writing to the Sub-Subcontractor by the Sub-Contractor. The value of such authorised variations shall be determined by measurement and valuation at the rates and prices stated or referred to in the Sub-Subcontract Order. If there are no such rates or prices or if they are not applicable, then the value shall be such as is reasonable in all the circumstances.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:11. Assignment/sub-letting:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall not assign or sublet the Sub-Subcontract Works or any part thereof without the prior written consent of the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.1} The Sub-Subcontractor shall not less than 5 days before the monthly Valuation Date submit to the Sub-Contractor a written application for payment for all work properly executed at the date of the statement, which shall contain such details as the Sub-Contractor may reasonably require and the value shall be calculated in accordance with the rates and prices, if any, specified in the Sub-Subcontract. The Due Date for payment of any sums under this Sub-Subcontract shall be in accordance with The Schedule of Valuation and Payment Dates (Document 9).

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor and the Sub-Subcontractor agree that it will be a condition precedent to the Sub-Subcontractor's right to payment under this Sub-Subcontract that a written application for payment is submitted by the Sub-Subcontractor in accordance with these terms.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.2} Subject to clauses 12.3, 12.4 or 12.5 the Sub-Contractor shall pay to the Sub-Subcontractor the value of work properly executed in accordance with The Schedule of Valuation and Payment Dates (Document 9). All payments to the Sub-Subcontractor shall be the total value of work properly executed, less:

children.name: text
children: {b:12.2.1} any previous payments and any discounts and retentions provided for in the Order;

children.name: text
children: {b:12.2.2} such sum as the Sub-Contractor estimates to be an amount equal to any amount of expense, damage, loss or other costs or liabilities whatsoever caused to the Sub-Contractor by reason of any breach by the Sub-Subcontractor of this or any other contract between the parties or any failure by the Sub-Subcontractor to complete the Sub-Subcontract Works within the period for completion or any revised period as provided in clause 9; and

children.name: text
children: {b:12.2.3} an amount equal to any amount to which the Sub-Contractor is entitled to payment from the Sub-Subcontractor under this or any other contract between the parties.

children.name: text
children: The exercise by the Sub-Contractor of its rights under clauses 12.2.2 and 12.2.3 is without prejudice to and pending the final determination between the parties as to the amount of such expense, damage, loss or other liability, indemnity, contribution or payment.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:12.3 Payment Notice:}} The Sub-Contractor shall give notice on the dates specified in The Schedule of Valuation and Payment Dates (document 9) specifying the amount (if any) of the payment proposed to be made in respect of the Sub-Subcontract Works and the basis upon which such amount was calculated. Subject to clause 12.5 and unless the Sub-Contractor has served notice under clause 12.4 it shall pay the sum referred to in the Sub-Contractor's notice under this clause 12.3 (or, if the Sub-Contractor has not served notice under this clause 12.3, the sum referred to in the written statement issued by the Sub-Subcontractor pursuant to clause 12.1).

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:12.4 Payless Notice:}} Not later than 1 day before the final date for payment (the "{b:prescribed period}") the Sub-Contractor shall give notice of the sum the Sub-Contractor considers to be due on the date the notice is served and the basis on which that sum is calculated and, subject to clause 12.5, where such notice is given under this clause 12.4 the Sub-Contractor shall pay to the Sub-Subcontractor the amount stated in such notice on or before the final date for payment.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.5.1} the Sub-Subcontractor becomes {u:Insolvent} after the prescribed period but before the final date for payment the Sub-Contractor shall not be obliged to pay the Sub-Subcontractor any sum, or any part of it, due under this Sub-Subcontract; and/or

children.name: text
children: {b:12.5.2} on or before the final date for payment of any sums due to the Sub-Subcontractor under these terms the Employer or Contractor is Insolvent the Sub-Contractor shall not be obliged to pay any such sum to the Sub-Subcontractor unless and if so only to the extent that the Sub-Contractor receives payment in respect thereof from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: For the purposes of this clause 12.5 "{u:Insolvent}" shall have the meaning given to it by section 113 of Part 8 of the Construction Act 1996 (as amended).

children.name: text
children: {b:12.6} The parties acknowledge that the Value Added Tax (Section 55A) (Specified Services and Excepted Supplies) Order 2019/892 applies to the Sub-Subcontractor and that any payments made from the Sub-Contractor to the Sub-Subcontractor shall be made net of Value Added Tax. The Sub-Contractor confirms that it will pay to Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs the Value Added Tax applicable to sums paid to the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:12.7} The Sub-Contractor shall be under no obligation to set aside in a separate bank account any amount representing the retention. The Sub-Contractor shall be entitled to the full and entire beneficial interest in any interest accruing on the retention and shall be under no obligation to account to the Sub-Subcontractor for any such interest.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:13. Liability for defects:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall maintain the Sub-Subcontract Works and make good at no cost to the Sub-Contractor and in accordance with the Sub-Contractor's directions all defects, shrinkages and other faults ("{b:defects}") in the Sub-Subcontract Works or in any part thereof due to materials or workmanship not in accordance with the Sub-Subcontract or due to frost occurring before the date of practical completion of the Sub-Subcontract Works. If the Contractor makes a deduction in respect of any defects from the Sub-Contract Sum under the Sub-Contract, an appropriate deduction shall be made from the Sub-Subcontract sum.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:14. Insurance:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall effect and maintain suitable Employers' Liability and Public Liability Insurance for the duration of his obligations under the Sub-Subcontract. Such insurance must provide a limit of indemnity of at least the sum stated in the Order for any one occurrence and for an unlimited number of occurrences. The current Policies of Insurance shall be produced to the Sub-Contractor for inspection with the premium payment receipts.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:15. Use of services:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall be entitled at his own risk to the use of services and facilities stated in the Order, but subject thereto he shall provide everything necessary for the execution of the Sub-Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:16. Tax:}} The Sub-Subcontractor is required to be the holder of a valid Authorisation under the Income and Corporation Taxes Act 1988 and any Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:{u:17. Statutory requirements:}} The Sub-Subcontractor shall observe and perform all the obligations placed upon the Sub-Subcontract Works by statute including but not limited to the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002 and the Construction (Design & Management) Regulations 2015 (as amended from time to time).

children.name: text
children: {b:18.1} If the Sub-Subcontractor has a bankruptcy order made against him or, being a limited company, goes into administration, liquidation, or a receiver is appointed, the Sub-Contractor may without prejudice to any other rights, by notice* determine the Sub-Subcontract with immediate effect.

children.name: text
children: {b:18.2} If the Sub-Subcontractor breaches any fundamental term or condition of the Sub-Subcontract and such breach continues for 7 days following receipt of the Sub-Contractor's notice* specifying the breach to the Sub-Subcontractor, the Sub-Contractor may by further notice* to the Sub-Subcontractor forthwith determine the Sub-Subcontractor's employment under the Sub-Subcontract. Thereupon the Sub-Contractor may take possession of all materials, plant or other things whatsoever brought on to the site by the Sub-Subcontractor and may use them for the purpose of executing completing and maintaining the Sub-Subcontract Works. The Sub-Contractor may in lieu of determining the Sub-Subcontractor's employment give 7 days' notice* of his intention to take part only of the Sub-Subcontract Works out of the hands of the Sub-Subcontractor and arrange the execution, completion and maintenance of such part by others and recover the additional costs from the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:18.3} If the Sub-Contractor fails to pay in full any amount due by the final date for payment, the Sub-Subcontractor may suspend performance of the Sub-Subcontract works upon giving the Sub-Contractor 14 days' notice* of his intention to do so.

children.name: text
children: {b:*Notice of determination or suspension must in writing and given by actual delivery, registered post or recorded delivery and if sent by one of the latter two methods, subject to proof to the contrary, it will be deemed to have been received 48 hours after posting, excluding Saturday, Sunday and Bank Holidays.}

children.name: text
children: {b:19.1} If any dispute or difference arises under the Sub-Subcontract ("{em:dispute}") either party may refer it to adjudication in accordance with the Scheme for Construction Contracts 1998 (as amended).

children.name: text
children: {b:19.2} Subject to clause 19.1, any dispute shall be determined by legal proceedings or, if disputes under the Sub-Contract are to be determined by arbitration, referred to the arbitration of a person to be nominated at the request of either party by the nominating body named in the Sub-Contract and such arbitration will be subject to the same arbitration rules as apply under the Sub-Contract.

children: Sub-Subcontract Date of Commencement on site: {SubcontractDateCommencement}{br}{br}Sub-Subcontract Date for Completion: {SubcontractDateCompletion}{br}{br}Main Contract Date for Completion: {MainContractDateCompletion}

children.name: text
children: Required in accordance with the Contractor's policies.{br}RAMS review period by Client is three days.

children.name: text
children: {b:12 – PPE GUIDANCE FOR GLOVES - MINIMUM STANDARDS TO BE COMPLIED WITH}

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that no actions by it or its staff, labour, agents, supply chain, or any party acting on its behalf, place the Sub-Contractor in breach of the Sub-Contract in any way.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall be the single point of responsibility for completing the design and/or undertaking of the Sub-Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontract Documents make reference to the Subcontractor in relation to design and/or activities that would include the Sub-Subcontract Works, this shall be deemed included as part of this Subcontractor's Requirements document. The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that all requirements and obligations of the Subcontractor are complied with in respect of the same.

children.name: text
children: {b:Management & Supervision:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that there is a competent person in charge of their works at all times during the course of the Sub-Subcontract Works, capable of ensuring good H&S management is taking place in relation to their tasks. This person must also be capable of receiving and communicating site directions on site effectively. The Sub-subcontractor shall ensure that there is representation at weekly internal Black Hat meetings by their supervisor and that management attends fortnightly and also attends the monthly review meetings, including reporting on progress and any major co-ordination matters. The Sub-Subcontractor is encouraged to engage in regular constructive dialogue with the Subcontractor and any important and/or urgent matters shall be raised to the Subcontractor as soon as possible.

children.name: text
children: The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives register and sign in and out of the site on a daily basis (where applicable engaging with M-Site (or similar access software)).

children.name: text
children: The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives receive daily activity briefings and shall provide them with any necessary tool box talks to address specific risks. The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives working on behalf of the Sub-Subcontractor attend a site induction. The supervisor shall ensure that the Sub-Subcontractor maintains suitable records of H&S matters and provide that information to the Subcontractor when reasonably requested for purposes of reporting to the Main Contractor. This should include, but not be limited to, records of RAMS, tool box talks and task-specific briefings (and similar) provided by the Sub-Subcontractor to their workforce.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that their operatives wherever reasonably possible work the maximum hours available to them to complete the works to programme requirements. The Sub-Subcontractor is required to take necessary action to address any concerns raised by the Sub-Subcontractor or principal contractor in regard to operatives' working hours.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that all items provided to the Sub-Subcontractor by the Subcontractor are recorded and signed for. This shall include Supervisors maintaining up to date plant registers.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that only hi-viz vests provided by the Subcontractor are worn on site by the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that arm protection gauntlets are being worn properly and from the wrist up the forearm.

children.name: text
children: Sub-Subcontractors shall ensure that their operatives attend site with the correct PPE at all times and supervisors shall ensure the Sub-Subcontractor holds an appropriate supply of spares on site at all times. Should the Sub-Subcontractor become too reliant on the Sub-Contractor for supply of PPE, the Sub-Contractor reserves the right to charge for reimbursement of the costs of supplying spares.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that Sub-Subcontractor's deliveries are scheduled in accordance with the principal contractor's requirements. Goods should not be delivered too early or inefficiently, and should be distributed and stored with adequate protection taking into account the risk of damage. Pipe and duct racks shall be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor on each floor plate to store goods, along with any other compliant means of storing and distributing materials safely.

children.name: text
children: Sub-Subcontractor's management and supervision shall ensure that their work areas are kept tidy and free from unnecessary debris/waste that would otherwise cause a hazard. High standards are expected. Waste and excess materials shall be removed from the work area each day by the Sub-subcontractor's labour in accordance with the Sub-Subcontract. Failure to do so, may give rise to alternative labour doing this with the costs incurred in doing so being recovered from the Sub-Subcontractor's account.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that accurate weekly progress mark-ups are maintained and submitted to the Sub-Contractor each Friday together with records of QA audits, which must be undertaken weekly, or more frequently where appropriate.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that open ends to services are bagged off when not being worked on. Air tests shall be carried out at all times and in accordance with the inspection and test plans. Depth gauges shall be used at all times. Wet vacs shall be supplied by the Sub-Subcontractor and located in the vicinity whenever any pressure tests are taking place. Proof of PAT tests shall be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor for their equipment used on site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Compliance with Main Contractor's Requirements:} Specifically, the Sub-Subcontractor shall make himself aware and at all times comply with the main contractor's requirements for H&S procedures and standards including, but not limited to their minimum standards for PPE and training. This includes but is not limited to:

-    ensuring operatives wearing face-fit masks are clean shaven and that the correct masks are being worn for the task being undertaken;{br}{br}-    ensuring that correct PPE is worn in relation to risks of cuts to arms (by using gauntlets) and preventing damage to eyes (by using correct eye protection, including prescription eye protection where applicable).{br}{br}The Sub-Subcontractor has received a copy of the latest Overbury company standards document.

children.name: text
children: {b:Asbestos & Hazardous Materials:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that their workforce undertakes the necessary training and has the necessary awareness of the risks of asbestos and other hazardous materials. This includes what to do if and when it is encountered so that any risk to their health and of others is fully minimised.

children.name: text
children: {b:Testing Pressures:} Where the Sub-Subcontract Works include testing of pipework, please ensure that PRV's are set to 1.5 times the project working pressure, then lower them to working pressure immediately afterwards. Please ensure that the risk assessment and method statement reflect this.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality Management:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall provide a Quality Inspection & Test Plan prior to starting their works that identifies all hold points relating to the works where checks need to be made to demonstrate compliance. This shall be supported throughout the Sub-Subcontract Works where the Sub-Subcontractor shall undertake those checks together with any necessary remedial action taking place and provide documented evidence where required to support the quality management process.{br}{br}{em:PLEASE NOTE:} The Sub-Contract Sum will be adjusted to allocate a fair and reasonable value to the provision of completed QA checksheets. This sum will be paid when the correctly completed QA checksheets are provided by the Sub-Subcontractor to demonstrate compliance with the specification.

children.name: text
